description: Central Provincial Council - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1869/04 of 30.06.2014 the Minute of the Central Provincial Public Management Assistant's Service
categorisation: This gazette notification contains amendments to the service minute for the Central Provincial Public Management Assistants' Service, specifically addressing recruitment qualifications, examination procedures, promotion methods, and service requirements. This falls under public sector administration, service conditions, and recruitment matters, which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) for public service recruitment, qualifications, and administrative procedures.
